
## RESOURCE FOLDER

```bash

    # genome version
    GenomeVersion="hg19"
    # WES capture library
    WES_LIB="twist.exome.2.0"

    # wes resource folder
    PonResourceDir="/storage/references_and_index/${GenomeVersion}/hmftools/resources_wes_${WES_LIB}"
    PonSageVcfDir="${PonResourceDir}/pon_sage_germline_vcfs"
    PonSampleList=$(cat /data/pon/WES-panel.of.normals-${GenomeVersion}-${WES_LIB}/meta/sample.list)
    PonDataDir="/data/pon/WES-panel.of.normals-${GenomeVersion}-${WES_LIB}"
    mkdir -p ${PonSageVcfDir}

    # wes library targe target bed
    TARGET_BED=/storage/references_and_index/${GenomeVersion}/bed/${WES_LIB}/${GenomeVersion}_${WES_LIB}.target.bed
    INTVAL_MERGED_BED=${PonResourceDir}/${GenomeVersion}.interval.merged.target.bed
    bedtools sort -i ${TARGET_BED} | bedtools merge -i - > ${INTVAL_MERGED_BED}

```

## SAGE Germline VCF 생성

```bash
    qsub -q all.q@ngsnode1 /storage/home/kangsm/runScripts/00_Pipeline_Development/hmftools_wes/SGE_hmftools_wes_pon_preprocessing.sh
```

```bash

    # genome version
    GenomeVersion="hg19"
    # WES capture library
    WES_LIB="twist.exome.2.0"

    # wes resource folder
    PonResourceDir="/storage/references_and_index/${GenomeVersion}/hmftools/resources_wes_${WES_LIB}"
    PonSageVcfDir="${PonResourceDir}/pon_sage_germline_vcfs"
    PonSampleList=$(cat /data/pon/WES-panel.of.normals-${GenomeVersion}-${WES_LIB}/meta/sample.list)
    PonDataDir="/data/pon/WES-panel.of.normals-${GenomeVersion}-${WES_LIB}"

    SampleListFile=/data/pon/WES-panel.of.normals-hg19-twist.exome.2.0/meta/sample.list
    DataDir=/data/pon/WES-panel.of.normals-hg19-twist.exome.2.0
    for SID in $(cat ${SampleListFile} | awk '{print $1}')
    do
        ln -Tsf ${DataDir}/${SID}/hmftools/sage/${SID}.sage.germline.vcf.gz ${PonSageVcfDir}/${SID}.sage.germline.vcf.gz
    done


    # vcf list
    VCF_LIST=${PonResourceDir}/sage.vcf.list
    ls ${PonSageVcfDir} | grep -v tbi > ${VCF_LIST}

    # genome fasta (hg19)
    HMF_GENOME_FASTA="/storage/references_and_index/hg19/hmftools/Homo_sapiens.GRCh37.GATK.illumina.fasta"

    cd ${PonSageVcfDir}
    # vcf to tsv 
    for INPUT_VCF in $(cat ${VCF_LIST})
    do
        OUTPUT_TSV=${INPUT_VCF/sage.germline.vcf.gz/sage.germline.pon.raw.tsv}
        bcftools norm -f "${HMF_GENOME_FASTA}" -m -any --keep-sum AD "${INPUT_VCF}" -Ou \
            | bcftools view -f PASS -m2 -M2 -v snps,indels -Ou \
            | bcftools query -f '%CHROM\t%POS\t%REF\t%ALT[\t%AD]\n' > ${OUTPUT_TSV}
    done
```

```r
    GenomeVersion="hg19"
    WesLib="twist.exome.2.0"

    library(plyr)
    library(dplyr)
    sid_list=list.files(sprintf("/data/pon/WES-panel.of.normals-%s-%s", GenomeVersion, WesLib))
    
    WORK_DIR=sprintf("/storage/references_and_index/%s/hmftools/resources_wes_%s/pon_sage_germline_vcfs", GenomeVersion, WesLib)
    setwd(WORK_DIR)
    
    sage_pon_pooled = data.frame()

    for( sid in sid_list ){
        sage_tsv <- read.delim(sprintf("%s.sage.germline.pon.raw.tsv", sid),header=F) 
        colnames(sage_tsv) = c("CHROM","POS","REF","ALT","AD")
        sage_tsv$REF_COUNT = sapply(sage_tsv$AD, function(y) as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(y, ","))[1]) )
        sage_tsv$ALT_COUNT = sapply(sage_tsv$AD, function(y) sum(as.numeric(unlist(strsplit(y, ","))[-1])) )
        sage_tsv <- sage_tsv %>% mutate(
            VKEY=paste0(CHROM,"_",POS, "_",REF, "_", ALT),
            SAMPLE_ID=sid
        )
        sage_pon_pooled=rbind(sage_pon_pooled, sage_tsv)
        message(sprintf("%s done.",sid))
    }

    sage_pon_pooled %>% filter( ALT_COUNT > 0 ) %>% group_by(VKEY) %>% reframe(
        Chromosome=unique(CHROM),
        Position=unique(POS),
        Ref=unique(REF),
        Alt=unique(ALT),
        SamplesCount = length(SAMPLE_ID),
        MaxSampleReads = max(ALT_COUNT),
        TotalReads=sum(ALT_COUNT)
    ) %>% as.data.frame() -> SAGE_PON_TSV

    SAGE_PON_TSV = SAGE_PON_TSV %>% filter( SamplesCount >= 2)
    
    OUTPUT_FILE = sprintf("/storage/references_and_index/%s/hmftools/resources_wes_%s/WES_PANEL_OF_NORMALS.tsv", GenomeVersion, WesLib)
    write.table( SAGE_PON_TSV, OUTPUT_FILE, quote=F, col.names=T, row.names=F, sep="\t")

```


### GNOMAD STRIPPED VCF

- 한번만 작업후 공통 사용 (WES Capture Library 상관없음)

```bash
    # gnomAD 원본에서 필요한 필드(AF, AC, AN 등)만 남기고 압축 해제/재압축
    bcftools annotate -x ^INFO/AF,INFO/AC,INFO/AN,INFO/nhomalt gnomad.exomes.r2.1.1.sites.vcf.bgz \
    | bcftools annotate --rename-chrs chr_map.txt \
    | bcftools view -e 'INFO/AF < 0.0001' -Oz -o hg19.gnomad.v2.1.1.stripped.vcf.gz

    echo "Chromosome,Position,Ref,Alt,Frequency" > WES_GNOMAD.csv
    bcftools query -i 'INFO/AF != "."' -f '%CHROM,%POS,%REF,%ALT,%INFO/AF\n' hg19.gnomad.v2.1.1.stripped.vcf.gz >> WES_GNOMAD.csv
    bgzip -c WES_GNOMAD.csv > WES_GNOMAD.csv.gz
    
```

### AMBER LOCI

```r
    library(GenomicRanges)
    library(data.table)
    GenomeVersion="hg19"
    WesLib="twist.exome.2.0"
    WORK_DIR=sprintf("/storage/references_and_index/%s/hmftools/resources_wes_%s", GenomeVersion, WesLib)
    HMF_AMBER_LOCI_FILE = sprintf("/storage/references_and_index/%s/hmftools/resources_links/AMBER-GERMLINE-SITES.tsv.gz", GenomeVersion)
    NGS_LIB_TARGET_BED  = sprintf("%s/%s.interval.merged.target.bed", WORK_DIR, GenomeVersion)

    amber_resource = read.delim(gzfile(HMF_AMBER_LOCI_FILE))
    wes_regions    = read.delim(NGS_LIB_TARGET_BED, header=F)

    amber_GR = GRanges(amber_resource$Chromosome, IRanges(start=amber_resource$Position, end=amber_resource$Position) )
    wes_GR   = GRanges(wes_regions[,1], IRanges(start=wes_regions[,2], end=wes_regions[,3]))

    IntersectRegion = findOverlaps(amber_GR, wes_GR)

    wes_amber_region = amber_resource[queryHits(IntersectRegion), ]

    OUTPUT_FILE = sprintf("/storage/references_and_index/%s/hmftools/resources_wes_%s/WES_AMBER_LOCI.tsv", GenomeVersion, WesLib)
    write.table( wes_amber_region, OUTPUT_FILE, quote=F, col.names=T, row.names=F, sep="\t")

```

### COBALT diploid bed
```bash 
    GenomeVersion="hg19"
    WES_LIB="twist.exome.2.0"

    PonResourceDir="/storage/references_and_index/${GenomeVersion}/hmftools/resources_wes_${WES_LIB}"
    HMF_DIPLOID_BED=/storage/references_and_index/${GenomeVersion}/hmftools/resources_links/DIPLOID-REGIONS.bed.gz
    WES_TARGET_BED=${PonResourceDir}/${GenomeVersion}.interval.merged.target.bed
    
    bedtools intersect -a ${HMF_DIPLOID_BED} -b ${WES_TARGET_BED} -wa \
        | sort -k1,1V -k2,2n > DIPLOID_REGION.bed

```
